topic: Joachim Bodamer Prosopagnosia Clinical Discovery, Fusiform Face Detector Disconnect vs Voice Identity Rescue, Covert Palm-Sweat Recognition, and Two Percent Congenital Prevalence (Low-Poly Pastel v7)
